AHCINT 1.3.0.0-usos3 - MODIFIED version of AHCINT 1.3.0.0 (ages2001,
https://github.com/ages2001/AHCINT, tag v1.3.0.0 = commit 7be9c9b8), changed
by the USOS project on 2026-09-30 (usos1), 2026-10-03 (usos2) and
2026-10-04 (usos3). Not an
upstream release. Licence: GPL-3.0, as the original (LICENSE).

usos1 (patches/0001-usos1-flush-cache.patch):
- SYNCHRONIZE CACHE (10)/(16), SRB_FUNCTION_FLUSH and SRB_FUNCTION_SHUTDOWN
  send FLUSH CACHE (E7h) or FLUSH CACHE EXT (EAh) to the drive; FUA writes
  are followed by a flush; MODE SENSE returns the caching page (WCE from
  IDENTIFY word 85).

usos2 (patches/0002-usos2-target-check-and-trace.patch), after the first X470
run, where text-mode Setup copied files but nothing reached the disk:
- Before every command the port must have a link (SSTS.DET = 3) and a
  running command engine (PxCMD ST, FRE, CR, FR); otherwise the port is
  restarted once and the command fails instead of being issued.
- Counters (reads, writes, sectors written, errors, PRD byte count
  mismatches, engine restarts, flushes); a PRD byte count that does not
  match the request is counted.
- The USOS gap: on the one disk whose LBA 2046 holds the USOS marker
  ("USOSW2KTRACE", written by tools/w2k_stage.sh usos_w2k_gap_marker), the
  driver writes and reads back a test pattern at LBA 2045 at every start; a
  mismatch hides the port from Setup ("no hard disk" instead of copying
  into nothing). It increments the boot counter in the marker and writes an
  ASCII trace (counters, every port's SSTS/CMD/SIG/TFD and model) to LBA
  2040 + boot % 4, again every 2048 writes and at shutdown. Other disks are only read at LBA
  2046.

usos3 (patches/0003-usos3-screen-stages-readback-fail-loudly.patch), a
diagnostic build after the second X470 run (text mode copied with its
progress bar, then a black screen with a blinking cursor; nothing on the
disk, not even the usos2 marker update):
- A status line per HBA in the VGA text buffer (row 0, a second HBA row 1):
  PCI ID, port, marker result at LBA 2046 (OK / NO / RE read error), the
  write test, completed reads and writes, errors, last written LBA and the
  stages; refreshed every 64 commands, on every error and every stage.
  Reads rising during the file copy show that AHCINT is the driver serving
  the disk.
- Stages (status line and trace): first write to LBA 0, first write over
  LBA 2048, first flush, shutdown, read-back failure, write/read error,
  bugcheck. The first four written LBAs, the last error (LBA, TFD, command)
  and read-back counters are in the trace (now only ports with a device).
- Sampled read-back on the USOS disk: the first sector of the first 256
  writes and of every 32nd after is read back and compared.
- Fail loudly: a marker read that fails 3 times, a failed write test or a
  read-back mismatch stops with STOP 0x55534F53 (P1 1/2/3, P2 PCI ID,
  P3 port, P4 TFD or LBA) after the line and the trace are written (usos2
  returned silently or hid the port).
- A bugcheck callback puts the STOP code on the line and writes it to the
  trace (AHCINT polls, so this works with every other CPU stopped).
Imports added: MmMapIoSpace, KeRegisterBugCheckCallback, KeBugCheckEx,
KiBugCheckData (ntoskrnl, all on 2000 SP4).

Every changed spot in src/ is marked "MODIFIED (USOS 1.3.0.0-usosN)".
Built with WDK 7.1 (build.cmd, x86 WXP target); every import (16: ntoskrnl,
scsiport) resolves on the Windows 2000 SP4 kernel and scsiport.
